items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Herb Gregory was a trombone player who could play.

ctx.x: Sure. Well, who all was on that? Who was in there that morning?

Higgenbotham. Herb Gregory. He was always starting something. Herb Gregory was a trombone player who could play. He was partly a boozer, but he was on time. But he had something about him. He drank so much that every time you spoke to him there was whiskey on his breath, see. So that annoyed some leaders, I guess. And he looked red-eyed. But the man could play a whole lot of trombone. That's somebody that they overlook.
